content.text: At Drumclog, the Covenanters defeat Claverhouse’s royal troops. Morton saves wounded Lord Evandale, who escapes to Tillietudlem; the prisoners are freed, and the insurgents camp near the battlefield. Morton joins their council, despite condemning fanaticism and unlawful violence. They attack Tillietudlem, but its garrison resists until famine and mutiny force evacuation; Evandale returns, secures the soldiers’ submission, and escorts Lady Margaret, Edith, and others toward Edinburgh. Morton and Poundtext later travel to the insurgent camp near Hamilton. The Covenanters march on Glasgow but are repulsed, then occupy it after Claverhouse withdraws. At Bothwell Bridge, Morton unsuccessfully seeks peace from Monmouth; factionalism cripples the rebel army. Royal forces cross the bridge and rout them. Morton flees with Cuddie, reaches a farmhouse, and is captured by fanatics who plan to execute him. Claverhouse’s dragoons intervene, rescue Morton, and kill several Cameronians.
